import "array"
import "strings"

rawData = from(bucket: "pihole")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "upstreams")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

// Split raw string by ","
rows = strings.split(v: rawData._value, t: ",")

// Turn array into a stream
rowStream = array.from(rows: rows |> array.map(fn: (x) => ({ x: x })))

// Map and split each row into fields
parsed = rowStream
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      parts = strings.split(v: r.x, t: "|")
      return {
        source: parts[0],
        host: parts[1],
        port: int(v: parts[2]),
        queries: int(v: parts[3]),
        avg_latency: float(v: parts[4]),
        stddev_latency: float(v: parts[5])
      }
  })

parsed

import "array"
import "strings"

rawData = from(bucket: "pihole")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "top_clients")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

rows = strings.split(v: rawData._value, t: ",")

rowStream = array.from(rows: rows |> array.map(fn: (x) => ({ x: x })))

parsed = rowStream
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      parts = strings.split(v: r.x, t: "|")
      return {
        client: parts[0],
        name: if strings.strlen(v: parts[1]) == 0 then "Unknown" else parts[1],
        queries: int(v: parts[2]),
      }
  })

parsed
